name: Judge0
summary: Open-source sandboxed code execution system for 90+ languages; self-host or use Judge0 Cloud (via Rapid or direct).
description: Judge0 is a robust, scalable online code execution system used to run untrusted and AI-generated code in sandboxes. It supports 90+ languages, compile and runtime limits, additional files alongside a program, and webhooks, behind a REST API. Two flavors: Judge0 CE and Judge0 Extra CE (different language sets). Self-host with Docker, or use the managed Judge0 Cloud through Rapid (RapidAPI) or directly. Licensed GPL-3.0; last tagged release v1.13.1 (Apr 2024), repo still active. Judge0's sandbox (Isolate) needs cgroup v1: the v1.13 install notes say to add `systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=0` to GRUB, and cgroup v2 support is still an open issue. In judge0.conf, telemetry is on by default (JUDGE0_TELEMETRY_ENABLE, see TELEMETRY.md) and ALLOW_ENABLE_NETWORK defaults to true, so submissions can request network access, although ENABLE_NETWORK defaults to false.

agent_access.notes: Self-hosted instances can run without auth; Judge0 Cloud via RapidAPI uses an X-RapidAPI-Key header.
